title: LeetCode 73: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: Given an `m x n` integer matrix `matrix`, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0's. Return the modified matrix.
constraints:
1 <= m, n <= 200
• Time: O(M*N) | Space: O(M + N)
explanation: Collects row and column zero coordinates in sets, then overwrites corresponding rows and columns in O(M*N) time.
